messages.subject: Project Lyra - draft Series C term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Please find attached the first draft of the Series C term sheet for review before we send to Marisdale. Key points to flag:

- Pre-money £120m, £30m new money, £15.00 per share, 20% to the new round
- 1.0x non-participating liquidation preference, Series C ranking ahead of Series B
- One Marisdale board seat plus an observer; reserved matters broadly as per Kestrel
- EMI pool topped up to 12% pre-money
- Exclusivity to 30 June, company contributes up to £75k to Marisdale's legal fees

Grateful for comments - happy to jump on a call tomorrow.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
